summaries.title: JudgeLM: Fine-tuned Large Language Models are Scalable Judges
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**AI4Science与记忆评测**（Science & Eval）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **JudgeLM** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）。核心论点主张：To address this problem, we propose to fine-tune LLMs as scalable judges (JudgeLM) to evaluate LLMs efficiently and effectively in open-ended benchmarks。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **7B, 13B, 33B parameters, 5K samples**。实验设计与验证细节：We first propose a comprehensive, large-scale, high-quality dataset containing task seeds, LLMs-generated answers, and GPT-4-generated judgments for fine-tuning...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **90%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（JudgeLM obtains the state-of-the-art judge performance on both the existing PandaLM benchmark and our proposed new...；JudgeLM obtains high agreement with the teacher judge, achieving an agreement exceeding 90% that even surpasses...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 35 赞），本工作为突破 **全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: HyperFields: Towards Zero-Shot Generation of NeRFs from Text
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限」痛点，作者围绕 **HyperFields** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖分布外泛化（Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Generalization）、零样本泛化（Zero-Shot Generalization）。核心论点主张：We introduce HyperFields, a method for generating text-conditioned Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) with a single forward pass and (optionally) some fine-tuning。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制、师生知识蒸馏与能力迁移、受控干预消融与多范式系统对比。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Our ablation experiments show that both the dynamic architecture and NeRF distillation are critical to the expressivity of HyperFields。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **10× faster**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We further demonstrate that HyperFields learns a more general map between text and NeRFs, and consequently is...；Our ablation experiments show that both the dynamic architecture and NeRF distillation are critical to the...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 15 赞），本工作为突破 **合成数据与精细化配比 (Data Curation)、3D高斯泼溅与资产绑定 (3DGS & Rigging)** 中的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
